scene: The horse sprouts wings and leaps off the carousel onto Carnival Boulevard.
picture: A flat side view of cobblestone Carnival Boulevard under neon lights. Far left, a glowing blue night bus idle at a marked post. Centre-left, the player dismounts his brass winged horse. Centre-right, an open brass book cart lift suspended up high on a post. Far right, a striped bicycle rickshaw parked by a sign.
shown: a glowing blue night bus waiting at the curb on the far left
a striped bicycle rickshaw with a bell parked on the far right
an open brass book cart lift with lever up high on a post
